skillLevel.beginner: You will start with short, step-by-step lessons that keep the pace approachable.
skillLevel.intermediate: You will get a quick refresh, then move into guided practice right away.
skillLevel.advanced: You will jump into more demanding patterns and deeper technique work.
skillLevel.default: You will start with a personalized lesson path matched to your level.

goal.learnBasics: Your first lessons will focus on the core stitches and how they fit together.

goal.buildHabit: Your plan will favor lighter sessions that are easier to repeat consistently.
goal.default: Your plan will focus on the outcome that matters most to you.
